# Gaby Padilla Makeup Artist

> Professional makeup artist and cosmetologist with 20 years of experience, based in Playas de Tijuana, Baja California, Mexico. Makeup and hairstyling for brides, quinceañeras and special events, plus facial treatments. Serves Playas de Tijuana, Tijuana, Tecate and Valle de Guadalupe. Spanish and English.

## Services (Spanish / English)
- [Maquillaje y peinado en Tijuana](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/): services, prices in MXN, portfolio, FAQ
- [Makeup and hairstyling in Tijuana](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/en/): English version
- [Novias / Bridal](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/novias/): bridal package, what is included, process, FAQ ([English](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/en/bridal/))
- [XV años / Quinceañera](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/xv-anos/): quinceañera package and FAQ ([English](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/en/quinceanera/))
- [Tienda](https://gabypadillamakeup.com/tienda/): makeup and skincare products, ordered by WhatsApp
